items.title: Taste: keep the bug-to-PR workflow, or switch to a non-code business workflow (customer escalation, payments reconciliation) given Slack Code and Switch-template saturation

options.text: Keep bug-to-PR with the room-constraint twist (recommended): it is built on the spike-gated hypothesis and has a legible 3-minute demo
Switch to a non-code workflow: less crowded, but restarts design and loses the PR/branch evidence

items.title: Taste: second provider stays deferred, or price it inside the spike

options.text: Stay deferred (recommended): you have Claude Code only and time is the constraint
Price a thin second provider in the spike: stronger Switch story, costs spike time

items.title: Taste: build the 8-state machine MVP-first (report, repro, fix, one reject, approve), or simplify the spec to 5 states now

options.text: Keep the 8-state spec, build MVP path first (recommended): all edge cases are already decided
Simplify to 5 states now: less spec to read, loses ESCALATED/CLOSED behavior

items.title: Taste: keep the original file arrangement (~16 files) or a smaller single-YAML arrangement

options.text: Keep the original arrangement (recommended): the smaller one would drop the accepted docs/errors.md obligation
Smaller arrangement: fewer files, but reopens accepted DX obligations

items.title: Taste: prompt-enforced human gate for the MVP (advisory if the spike finds no hook), or a deterministic controller from day one

options.text: Prompt-enforced MVP, controller post-MVP (recommended): the spike may show a controller cannot be hosted
Controller from day one: real enforcement, but adds a component before the MVP exists

items.title: Taste: the fixer never holds the GitHub token (push-pr script does), or the fixer holds a demo-scoped token with a trusted-repo caveat

options.text: push-pr script holds the token (recommended): removes the exfiltration path for one small script
Fixer holds the token: fewer parts, but prompt injection can leak it

items.title: Taste: chat commands are bare words (approve, reject), or use a `!` prefix

options.text: Bare words, creator-only and state-gated (recommended): matches the transcript and reads naturally
`!approve` prefix: avoids collisions with normal talk, less readable in the demo

items.title: Taste: dry-run is the default live quickstart, or live-with-GitHub first

options.text: Dry-run first (recommended): no GitHub token or branch protection on the first run
Live first: more impressive, more setup before anything works
